description: Draw a static barcode: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14 and GS1-128 (check digits added or verified), Code 128, Code 39, or the 2D Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. Checks the value against the format's rules (characters, length, check digit) and says what it added. Options: bar and background colors, bar height, quiet zone, scale, the text under the bars and rotation. Returns a PNG and public image URLs (SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, PDF and EPS) for embedding or printing. No account needed.

bg.description: Background color (default ffffff) as hex, such as 000000 (in URLs leave out the # or encode it as %23)

data.description: The number or text to encode. Retail numbers (EAN, UPC, ITF-14, GS1 GTINs and SSCCs) can leave the check digit off and it's added; a wrong one is an error.

fg.description: Bar and text color (default 000000) as hex, such as 000000 (in URLs leave out the # or encode it as %23)

format.description: The symbology: ean13, ean8, upca, upce, code128, code39, itf14, gs1-128, datamatrix, pdf417, aztec (EAN-13 and UPC-A for retail products, ITF-14 for cartons, GS1-128 for logistics labels, Code 128 for your own labels, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec for 2D)

height.description: Bar height of linear barcodes in millimetres at the vector size (5-60; default depends on the format)

include_svg.description: Also return the SVG markup as text, e.g. to save an .svg file

quietZone.description: Blank margin in modules: left and right of linear barcodes (up to 20), all round 2D codes (up to 10). Defaults to the format's minimum.

scale.description: Pixels per module in raster images (1-10, default 4)

text.description: Print the digits or text under linear barcodes (default true)

name: generate_barcode
title: Generate a barcode
